prereg.amendment1_rule: pass = present in READ, absent in BLIND (forward maps with the reading side's statistics, his convention) and absent in the 180 degree negative. BLIND_OWN is still built, shown and scored, but as description only. Unclear can only fail. The control must pass or the confirmation is VOID; this is the only attempt.

review.rule: VALID only if at least one flagged control window overlaps his letter boxes

neighbour.rule: pass = present at d+1 and at d0 or d+2, absent in the 180 degree negative; unclear can only fail; the control window must pass or the check is VOID (Amendments 4 to 6, results/fl/PREREGISTRATION_FL_0483B.md)

confirm.rule: pass = present in READ, absent in BLIND and absent in the 180 degree negative; BLIND_OWN is description only; unclear can only fail; the control window must pass or the confirmation is VOID (Amendment 1, results/fl/PREREGISTRATION_FL_0483B.md)
